general.title: Flight Intelligence: The Power of Work IQ
general.why_useful: Microsoft developers explain how Work IQ grounds AI assistance in organizational context and reusable workflow knowledge, then connect that grounding to practical agent experiences.
general.connection: Agent usefulness depends on relevant business context as much as model capability; this walkthrough gives readers concrete criteria for judging whether a workplace agent can act with the right knowledge and boundaries.
